template.name: Donchian Breakout
template.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,{p0}) and close > ema(close,{p1}) and rsi(close,{p2}) > 50
template.notes: 20-bar Donchian upper breakout (prior-bar channel high per DSL) confirmed by EMA(50) trend and RSI(14) > 50; exit on opposite 10-bar lower breakout (ExitLength=10 documented). Corpus ATR-based stop (AtrMultiplier=1.5, AtrLength=14) not representable as fixed pct; left null. Documented volume/ATR envelope filters omitted as values are undocumented.
